content:
Rain arrived in Nuevo Laredo very early on Thursday, October 29 — earlier than expected — and several neighborhoods woke up with water on their streets, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

The colonias named in the report were El Nogal, Los Presidentes, Los Encinos, and Los Fresnos, with wet roadways including Avenida Reforma and Lago de Chapala. The report did not mention any road closures, school or business closures, or specific flooding damage.

The early rain caught the forecast off guard in timing, if not in substance: the highest rain chances had been expected after midday, especially between 2:00 and 5:00 p.m., with possible showers and some storms, and rain was expected to continue through the rest of the day. No extreme temperature drop was expected, though conditions could feel cooler in the afternoon and evening depending on how the cold front evolved.

Residents were advised to carry an umbrella or raincoat, drive cautiously in the rain, and stay attentive to Protección Civil advisories.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "Llegan las lluvias a Nuevo Laredo; varias colonias de la ciudad despiertan con agua," October 29, 2026
